title: Discord Nitro
description: GET 1 MONTH OF DISCORD NITRO ON US. Offer ends June 7, 2023 at 11:59pm EDT. Play with the newest Nitro releases like custom Color Themes, Super Reactions, and Soundboard and enjoy upgraded voice and text chat features that gamers know and love.
longDescription:
With Nitro, you’ll enjoy awesome perks that make gaming and hanging out on Discord as fun as ever. Level up your fun with game-changing perks like HD streaming, bigger file uploads, and new Nitro releases like Soundboard audio reactions, animated Super Reactions, and custom Color Themes for your Discord app. 

# Create an Invite-Only Space For Your Friends or Clan 

- Discord servers are organized into topic-based channels where you can collaborate, share, and just talk about your day without clogging up a group chat.
- Voice channels make hanging out online easy. Grab a seat in a voice channel when you’re free. Friends can see you’re around and pop in to talk, without having to call.
- Stay connected with best-in-class tech. It’s like you’re all in the same room with low latency voice and video. 

# It’s Fun Being Yourself and Owning Your Vibe
- Color Themes for your Discord app: Match your vibe to any of 16 unique theme colors
- Use custom and animated emoji and stickers anywhere for more fun in your chats 
- Profile Upgrades: Style your profile with your own animated avatar, banner image, profile theme, and Avatar Decorations for maximum personality 
- Server Profiles: Be who you want in any server by customizing your profile details for each server

# Enhance Your Discord Experience 

- Upload files up to 500 MB so you can share videos, photos, and more with ease 
- HD Streaming: Share your screen and gameplay in crisp, high resolution for maximum viewing enjoyment 
- Access to all Activities including games that anyone in your server can play 
- 2 Boosts + 30% off extra Boosts: Get 2 Server Boosts to bless your favorite servers. Plus, enjoy 30% off any additional future Boost purchases
